BiblicalUsage: Mud and clay are what enemies are beaten into and what princes are trodden like. David says he beat them as small as the dust of the earth and stamped them as the mire of the street, and Isaiah says the one raised up from the north shall come upon princes as upon mortar, as the potter treads clay.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the picture is humbling on both sides: men become mud under God's judgment, and even princes are clay under the potter's foot.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
